note: Natural Founding includes a scripted player choosing Foraging and designating one real brood room; all food, workers and digging remain earned. Provisioned Founding explicitly supplies 2000 workers per colony, 20% soldiers in rivals, extra room cells and legal stored food. The preparation fixture keeps 8 free protein per colony to exercise the royal reserve before paid projects can start. Panels open; full individual 30Hz fixed ticks and 4x progression. Clarity run: 96-event histories or work reports open; natural checkpoints 0/180/360/540s avoid the daughter finish boundary. Synthetic records are explicitly UI fixture history, not extra world activity.
